I've saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki and told Anselm in their DM. Nothing has been sent; the draft waits in drafts until someone sends it.

- **Draft:** it goes to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101-per-seat figure, credits Marcus as the source and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis not to pass the rate on without approval from Anselm or June.
- **Why it was allowed:** Hollis isn't on the finance list, so the rate needed approval from Anselm or June. Anselm is the CFO and approved it directly, so I didn't need a separate approval request. The mail stays inside pemberline.com, so Ruth's sign-off wasn't needed.
- **Where the figure came from:** I used the rate exactly as Anselm stated it. I couldn't check it against an account file, because there are no Thornbury Cloth Co. files in the share, and GBrain had nothing on it either (its search is keyword-only). I didn't read Marcus's DMs, since Anselm can't see them.
